ref: Ghosal & van der Vaart (2017), Ch 3, Eq 3.5, p. 32

title: Posterior Dirichlet distribution of the first k weights after marginalizing over the remaining cells, depending only on (N_1, ..., N_k)
formula: Dir( k+1; alpha_1 + N_1, ..., alpha_k + N_k, sum_{j=k+1}^{infty} alpha_j + n - sum_{j=1}^{k} N_j )
ref: Ghosal & van der Vaart (2017), Ch 3, Eq 3.6, p. 32

title: Posterior mean of the j-th weight in a countable Dirichlet process given n observations with cell counts N_j
formula: E(p_j | X_1, ..., X_n) = (alpha_j + N_j) / ( sum_{l=1}^{infty} alpha_l + n )
ref: Ghosal & van der Vaart (2017), Ch 3, Eq 3.7, p. 32

title: Posterior variance of the j-th weight in a countable Dirichlet process given n observations with cell counts N_j
formula: var(p_j | X_1, ..., X_n) = (alpha_j + N_j) * ( sum_{l != j} alpha_l + n - N_j ) / ( ( sum_{l=1}^{infty} alpha_l + n )^2 * ( sum_{l=1}^{infty} alpha_l + n + 1 ) )
ref: Ghosal & van der Vaart (2017), Ch 3, Eq 3.8, p. 33

title: Posterior covariance between the j-th and j'-th weights of a countable Dirichlet process given n observations
formula: cov(p_j, p_{j'} | X_1, ..., X_n) = - (alpha_j + N_j) * (alpha_{j'} + N_{j'}) / ( ( sum_{l=1}^{infty} alpha_l + n )^2 * ( sum_{l=1}^{infty} alpha_l + n + 1 ) )
ref: Ghosal & van der Vaart (2017), Ch 3, Eq 3.9, p. 33

title: Discrete random probability measure on X expressed as an infinite weighted sum of point masses at random locations theta_i with stick-breaking weights W_i
ref: Ghosal & van der Vaart (2017), Ch 3, Eq 3.10, p. 34

title: Splitting variables V at level epsilon defined as the conditional probabilities of the offspring sets given the parent set in a tree-based prior
formula: V_{epsilon 0} = P(A_{epsilon 0} | A_epsilon),   V_{epsilon 1} = P(A_{epsilon 1} | A_epsilon)
ref: Ghosal & van der Vaart (2017), Ch 3, Eq 3.11, p. 37

title: Probability assigned by a tree-based random measure to a partitioning set as a product of splitting variables along the path from the root
formula: P(A_{epsilon_1 ... epsilon_m}) = V_{epsilon_1} * V_{epsilon_1 epsilon_2} * ... * V_{epsilon_1 ... epsilon_m}
ref: Ghosal & van der Vaart (2017), Ch 3, Eq 3.12, p. 37

title: Necessary-and-sufficient mean-zero conditions for a tree-based finitely additive measure on R to extend to a countably additive random measure
formula: E[ V_epsilon * V_{epsilon 0} * V_{epsilon 0 0} * ... ] = 0   for all epsilon in E*,   and E[ V_1 * V_{1 1} * V_{1 1 1} * ... ] = 0
ref: Ghosal & van der Vaart (2017), Ch 3, Eq 3.13, p. 38

title: Bound on the expected squared maximum of partition probabilities for a tail-free process when sup E[V_epsilon^2] < 1/2, decaying geometrically in level m
formula: E[ max_{epsilon in E^m} P(A_epsilon) ]^2 <= sum_{epsilon in E^m} prod_{j=1}^{m} E(V_{epsilon_1 ... epsilon_j}^2) <= 2^m * (r/2)^m = r^m
ref: Ghosal & van der Vaart (2017), Ch 3, Eq 3.14, p. 40

title: Sufficient condition on the splitting variables ensuring that almost all realizations of a tail-free random measure are absolutely continuous with respect to mu
formula: sup_{m in N} max_{epsilon in E^m} E( prod_{j=1}^{m} V_{epsilon_1 ... epsilon_j}^2 ) / mu^2( A_{epsilon_1 ... epsilon_m} ) < infty
ref: Ghosal & van der Vaart (2017), Ch 3, Eq 3.16, p. 44

title: Summability conditions on the means and variances of splitting variables that imply canonical absolute continuity of a tail-free process
formula: sum_{m=1}^{infty} max_{epsilon in E^m} | E(V_epsilon) - 1/2 | < infty,   sum_{m=1}^{infty} max_{epsilon in E^m} var(V_epsilon) < infty
ref: Ghosal & van der Vaart (2017), Ch 3, Eq 3.17, p. 44

title: Density of a tail-free random measure as the infinite product of doubled splitting variables along the binary expansion of the point x
ref: Ghosal & van der Vaart (2017), Ch 3, Eq 3.18, p. 44

title: Finite-level density p_m of a tail-free measure obtained by averaging P(A_epsilon)/mu(A_epsilon) over the level-m partition cells
formula: p_m = sum_{epsilon in E^m} ( P(A_epsilon) / mu(A_epsilon) ) * 1_{A_epsilon}
ref: Ghosal & van der Vaart (2017), Ch 3, Eq 3.19, p. 44

title: Lower bound on the prior probability of approximating a target density p_0 in L1, used to establish that the total-variation support contains all densities absolutely continuous with respect to mu
formula: Pi( integral | p / p_m - 1 | d mu < epsilon / ( 2 ||p_0||_infty + epsilon ) ) * Pi( || p_m - p_0 ||_infty < epsilon / 2 )
ref: Ghosal & van der Vaart (2017), Ch 3, Eq 3.20, p. 47

title: First and second moments of partitioning-set probabilities under a Polya tree process with parameters alpha_epsilon
formula: E( P(A_{epsilon_1 ... epsilon_m}) ) = prod_{j=1}^{m} alpha_{epsilon_1 ... epsilon_j} / ( alpha_{epsilon_1 ... epsilon_{j-1} 0} + alpha_{epsilon_1 ... epsilon_{j-1} 1} );   E( P(A_{epsilon_1 ... epsilon_m})^2 ) = prod_{j=1}^{m} alpha_{epsilon_1 ... epsilon_j} ( alpha_{epsilon_1 ... epsilon_j} + 1 ) / ( ( alpha_{epsilon_1 ... epsilon_{j-1} 0} + alpha_{epsilon_1 ... epsilon_{j-1} 1} ) ( alpha_{epsilon_1 ... epsilon_{j-1} 0} + alpha_{epsilon_1 ... epsilon_{j-1} 1} + 1 ) )
ref: Ghosal & van der Vaart (2017), Ch 3, Eq 3.21, p. 49

title: First and second moments of the Polya-tree density p(x) for a canonical Polya tree process with absolutely-continuous realizations
ref: Ghosal & van der Vaart (2017), Ch 3, Eq 3.22, p. 49

title: Posterior expected density at x for a canonical Polya tree process with rate sequence a_m, given an i.i.d. sample with level-j cell counts N_{x_1 ... x_j}
ref: Ghosal & van der Vaart (2017), Ch 3, Eq 3.23, p. 50

title: Posterior expected density given hyperparameter theta for a Polya-tree mixture with elicited mean density g_theta and rate sequence a_m
formula: E( p(x) | theta, X_1, ..., X_n ) = g_theta(x) * prod_{j=1}^{infty} ( 2 * a_j + 2 * N_{G_theta(x)_1 ... G_theta(x)_j} ) / ( 2 * a_j + N_{G_theta(x)_1 ... G_theta(x)_{j-1}} )
ref: Ghosal & van der Vaart (2017), Ch 3, Eq 3.24, p. 53

title: Two-sided product bounds on the Polya-tree posterior density factor used to control its tail when sum a_j^{-1} is finite
formula: prod_{j>m} ( 1 - n / (2 * a_j) )  <=  prod_{j>m} ( 2 * a_j + 2 * N_{G_theta(x)_1 ... G_theta(x)_j} ) / ( 2 * a_j + N_{G_theta(x)_1 ... G_theta(x)_{j-1}} )  <=  prod_{j>m} ( 1 + n / a_j )
ref: Ghosal & van der Vaart (2017), Ch 3, Eq 3.25, p. 54

title: Polya-tree mixture of the second kind: mean density g_theta expressed as a product over levels of doubled theta-dependent alpha parameters
formula: g_theta(x) = prod_{j=1}^{infty} 2 * alpha_{x_1 ... x_j}(theta) / ( alpha_{x_1 ... x_{j-1} 0}(theta) + alpha_{x_1 ... x_{j-1} 1}(theta) )
